rules.description: Warn when modifying compiled PlayCanvas engine/bundle files
rules.message: This file is part of the compiled PlayCanvas engine/bundle. Read fully before editing, patch surgically, and verify syntax.

rules.description: Only use valid enum values from config.json — never invent values
rules.message: Read config.json assets.*.data.scripts.*.attributes.*.enum.options before setting any script attribute.

rules.description: Asset replacement path must match config.json url field exactly
rules.message: Look up the asset's url in config.json before overwriting — path must be exact.

rules.description: Replacement images should match original dimensions
rules.message: Use sips or PIL to resize to original dimensions to avoid layout issues.

rules.description: SVG files cannot be used as PlayCanvas textures
rules.message: PlayCanvas uses WebGL textures — only PNG/JPG are valid. If you download an SVG, convert to PNG with sips before placing in files/assets/. Never rename .svg to .png.

rules.description: Any helper function added to __game-scripts.js must be called
rules.message: After patching __game-scripts.js with a new function, verify it is called in the rendering path. Search for the function name — it must appear at least twice (definition + call site). Dead code = no effect.

rules.description: Start/end nodes use endpoint_circle frame, not block
rules.message: If the user wants to modify start/end node visuals, patch the endpoint_circle rendering path. Blocks are obstacles — endpoints are the colored dots.

rules.description: NEVER reassign textureBlock or textureEndpointCircle in 2453710.json
rules.message: textureBlock and textureEndpointCircle are GLOBAL defaults. Changing them breaks ALL cells of that type. For per-color customization, ONLY overwrite the PNG files at the pre-wired per-color asset paths (textureEndpointRed=283500001, etc.). Do NOT modify 2453710.json attribute values.

rules.description: Per-color textures are pre-wired — do not edit 2453710.json or config.json
rules.message: The per-color texture attributes (textureEndpointRed, textureBlockRed, etc.) are ALREADY wired in 2453710.json and config.json. Just overwrite the placeholder PNG files at files/assets/283500001-283500016/1/*.png. No JSON edits needed.
